title: Burrowing Owl — AI upsizing
subtitle: A small Burrowing Owl capture (1954 × 1466) run through five 2× upsamplers and three 4× variants. Compare any pair side-by-side at native pixel resolution to see how much real detail each tool reconstructs vs. how much is plausible-looking confabulation.

title: Tiger Family — AI upsizing
subtitle: An adult tigress and her cub at Bandhavgarh tiger reserve, India, on a forest path at sunset. Captured at ISO 1250 on the OM-1 at 75 mm (150 mm equivalent), 1/640s f/4.5. The original 5184 px frame was cropped to a 1928 px sample around the adult tiger; that crop is the 1× baseline, and each 2× / 4× upsampler ran on it.
